markdown: **Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> (envision);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** A portion of the slain creature's life force travels through the blade and into your soul, bolstering your own life. You gain the benefits of the [Diehard](/Feats.aspx?ID=5140) feat for 1 minute. This causes you to die from the dying condition at dying 5 rather than dying 4.
